neighbours.label: the comma between a numbered division and its sub-division in a citation ('Article 4, Section 2'; 'hall 9, stand D06'), where a word like Section/paragraph comes next
fire: The right to a jury trial is guaranteed by Article 3, Section 2 of the state constitution.
Refunds are handled as laid out in Chapter 12, paragraph 4 of the consumer code.
The quorum rules can be found under Title 9, Section 31 of the municipal charter.
Visitors will find the Danish exhibitors in hall 7, stand B22 near the entrance.
The fee was set in accordance with Article 21, paragraph 2 of the treaty.
Data may be processed on the basis of art. 6, par. 1 of the regulation.
The veto procedure is explained in Part 2, Section 8 of the handbook.
The tenant relied on Schedule 4, clause 11 of the lease agreement.
quiet: The right to a jury trial is guaranteed by the third article of the state constitution.
Refunds are handled as laid out in the consumer code, which was revised last spring.
The quorum rules, though rarely read, can be found in the municipal charter.
Visitors will find the Danish exhibitors, as usual, near the main entrance.
The fee was set in 2014, two years after the treaty came into force.
Data may be processed only with consent, according to the regulation.
The veto procedure is explained in the second part of the handbook.
The tenant, a retired teacher, relied on the wording of the lease agreement.

notes: Card: peaks on ',' in 'Article 1, Section 9', 'hall 9, stands', 'art. 4, par. 1'; output direction (- pole) promotes Section/sections/part. Probes: 0.76-1.00 on three such commas, <0.01 on ordinary commas, 0.26 on 'vol. 2, p. 114'.
